message.content:
The height is \(x\).  
One base equals the height, so one base is \(x\).  
The other base is twice as long, so it is \(2x\).

Area of a trapezoid:
\[
A=\frac{1}{2}(\text{base}_1+\text{base}_2)(\text{height})
\]
\[
A=\frac{1}{2}(x+2x)(x)
\]
\[
A=\frac{1}{2}(3x)(x)
\]
\[
A=\frac{3x^2}{2}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{3x^2}{2}\).
